name: HPE Aruba Networking Central MCP Server
description: Exposes 90 production-grade tools for interacting with the complete HPE Aruba Networking Central REST API surface, including network inventory, configuration, and security management. It features enterprise-ready OAuth2 handling and semantic tool filtering for optimized performance with both hosted and local LLMs.
